job.title: [Post] Aditya Jain posted this
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I saw your e-commerce hiring post – I bring 5+ years of enterprise commerce development on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, SAP certified. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Java, Spring Boot and OCC REST APIs for headless and PWA storefronts
– PIM / ERP / MDM integration with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders
– Query performance tuning, CI/CD deployment cycles, code reviews

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring Boot & REST APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: E-commerce developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and query performance tuning, with proven PIM / ERP / MDM integrations and headless APIs for PWA frontends. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles, supports production, performs code reviews and works in agile, international teams with AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your post is about e-commerce delivery, which is the core of my career: more than five years on large B2B and B2C platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I want to bring that hands-on depth in Java, APIs and integrations to a team that builds and runs serious commerce platforms, in Germany or remote.

en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Developer
en.hook: Your e-commerce hiring post asks for developers who can deliver on large commerce platforms. That is what I have done for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and extend B2B and B2C platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud with Java and Spring, from headless APIs to ERP integration – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: E-commerce development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on Hybris 2211; maintained Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs and Impex.

bullets.label: APIs & headless
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefront, PWA frontends and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Integration
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved SAP ERP / MDM integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Performance & delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, executed CI/CD deployment cycles and performed code reviews.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a short call about the role.
